g.text: Expanding window: train on everything before a month, test on that month, move on one month - never shuffled
final model: the winner per target, retrained on all data
- 25 monthly folds (Oct 2024 - Oct 2026); the first needs a full year of history so the
seasonal baseline has seen every season once
- in every fold, all four models (persistence, climatology, majority class, LightGBM) are
refitted from scratch on the training data only - no future data, no shuffling
- scores (Brier, MAE, RMSE, skill) are computed over all test months together;
the model with the best score is retrained on all data and served
